notes.title: Update: Trixball! (and other game improvements)
notes.content:
Elastrix now has a new game mode added called Trixball! Instead of going through levels as in the regular game of Elastrix, Trixball is all about hitting high scores. It's a different way to play, and we hope you enjoy it.

Also, there have been a few small improvements in the game. The most noticeable one is the Trix path; now, when you shoot a Trix, a faint gray line will appear behind the Trix. This should give you a better idea of how to improve your shot. This has been added to both the regular levels and Trixball.
